plan.notes: Official 2025-26 Medical Assistant AAS program map (checksheet) from the NPC catalog. Blocks are the college's own term-by-term sequence; the map notes they are suggested for full-time students and may be adjusted. The map suggests taking the Block 3/4 general education courses in summer because MDA 124 & 125 meet 9 hours per week. All classes are offered online except MDA 124, MDA 125, MDA 126 and HES 109. Highlighted courses in the map lead to the Certificate of Proficiency as a Clinical Assistant / Certificate of Applied Science in Medical Assistant.

courses.title: Basic Technical Math
courses.choice_note: HES 101 or MAT 109 or higher - requires placement

courses.title: Medical Terminology for Clinical Health Professionals
Law and Ethics of the Health Care Professional
Human Body in Health and Disease
Basic Pharmacology
courses.choice_note: Prerequisites per map: HES 101, MAT 101 or MAT 109 or higher

courses.title: Clinical Procedures I
courses.choice_note: Prerequisites per map: HES 170, and BIO 160 or HES 190 - Fall semester only

courses.title: Arts and Humanities or Social and Behavioral Sciences
courses.choice_note: Arts and Humanities or Social and Behavioral Sciences - requires placement

courses.title: Physical and Biological Sciences Course
courses.choice_note: Physical and Biological Sciences course - requires placement

courses.title: Clinical Procedures II
courses.choice_note: Prerequisites per map: MDA 124; EMT 104 (or equivalent); HES 101 or MAT 101 or MAT 109 or higher. Co-requisites: BUS 119, HES 180. Spring semester only.

courses.title: Phlebotomy
courses.choice_note: Fall or Spring semester; immunizations, TB test, CPR/First Aid card required

courses.title: Communications Course
courses.choice_note: Communications course - not SPT 110 or SPT 120

courses.title: Medical Assistant Externship
courses.choice_note: Minimum grade of C to pass; may not retake. Requires immunizations, TB test, CPR/First Aid card, and DPS card; COVID-19 and/or flu vaccination or an approved waiver may be required. Paid or unpaid 160-hour summer internship in an ambulatory healthcare setting.
